# Nird Meds

> A local-first medication tracking PWA built on @niclaslindstedt/oss-framework.
> You enter your medications — a name, an optional dose, and the times of day
> they are taken — and log each dose with one tap. The log is stored on-device
> as JSON, with an optional copy synced to the user's own Dropbox or Google
> Drive. Adherence, streaks and the calendar's day marks are derived from the
> log at read time; nothing about adherence is stored.

- App: https://meds.niclaslindstedt.se/
- Source: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/meds
- Framework: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/oss-framework

## Features

- Today: the day's doses as a checklist grouped by time of day, cleared one
  tap per dose; opens first, unless there are no medications yet — then the
  add form does
- Medications: add, edit, stop and resume medications; stopping keeps the
  history, deleting is the guarded exception
- Calendar: a month at a glance — filled days where every dose landed, hollow
  part-done days, a warning tint on missed days — and any past day's checklist
  reopenable to log a forgotten dose
- History: adherence over the last 7 and 30 days, the current streak, a
  one-column-per-day chart that makes gaps visible, per-medication adherence,
  and the recent missed doses by name
- Settings: light/dark theme, week start, cloud sync, JSON backup and restore
- No account, no server, no analytics; installable and fully offline
